subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction discard an aborted assistant tool-call turn when no real tool result exists, matching the prompt-send sanitizer, rather than synthesize a result for the summarizer?
rationale: Both outcomes are valid transcript-repair policies with different user-visible context semantics; code review cannot choose the durable product policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the drop policy
options.body: Treat an aborted, unexecuted tool-call turn as unusable context and remove it before compaction sends messages to strict providers.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery semantics
options.body: Keep the partial turn only if maintainers define and test a provider-safe synthetic result contract that clearly communicates unknown execution state.

recommendation.title: Accept the drop policy
recommendation.body: Treat an aborted, unexecuted tool-call turn as unusable context and remove it before compaction sends messages to strict providers.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and is the strongest available routing candidate for the transcript-repair policy choice.
